biggest_catch: Drop is fully dead: the app no longer opens or functions as of 2026 and linked cards fail to connect.
catches: Wikipedia (Drop loyalty program): 'As of 2026, the app has ceased to open or function, and previously-synced credit cards fail to connect.'
doctorofcredit.com update (2/1/26): 'The app is now fully dead.'
Drop was sued in a Sept 2024 class action (Bloomberg Law) over points that could not be redeemed — gift cards were 'consistently sold out.'
Note: the unrelated crypto project 'Drop Protocol' also wound down in 2025 — a different company from Drop the loyalty app; both are dead, do not confuse them.

notes: Death evidence: Wikipedia 'Drop (loyalty program)': 'As of 2026, the app has ceased to open or function, and previously-synced credit cards fail to connect.' doctorofcredit.com update 2/1/26: 'The app is now fully dead.' Drop had been dying for years: a Sept 2024 class action (Bloomberg Law) alleged points could not be redeemed; Drop added 60-day redemption waits and removed direct purchase options in 2024. The crypto 'Drop Protocol' shutdown (mid-2025) is a separate company — do not cite it as Drop's death.
